reviewer_note: All 24 fine-tuned test outputs reviewed against the CLAUSE (source of truth), with the reference as guidance. Definitions (notebook 01): correct = valid JSON, right clause_type, obligation/party/trigger all supported by the clause; partially_correct = nothing invented but wrong clause_type or risk_flag, a secondary/incomplete obligation, or a missed/confused trigger; hallucinated = states an obligation, party, amount, deadline or condition not present in the clause. Drafted with AI assistance (Claude) and checked by the candidate. Second pass: the two outputs the LLM judge flagged (ex008, ex098) were re-reviewed; ex008 was relabelled hallucinated.
